title: hymenophyllum polyanthos var. sanguinolentum
intro: Hymenophyllum polyanthos var. sanguinolentum, commonly known as the "blood-stained fork fern", is a type of fern that belongs to the family Hymenophyllaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities, which can provide relief from various health issues. The health benefits of H. polyanthos var. sanguinolentum include its potential to aid in wound healing, reduce fever, and alleviate digestive problems. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
